name: Multipify — AI Store, Translation & WooCommerce Connector
author: multipify

sections.description:
Multipify connects WordPress and WooCommerce to the Multipify ecommerce platform and adds tools for multilingual ecommerce, AI-assisted translation, storefront creation and catalog management.

Use Multipify to translate a WordPress / WooCommerce store into multiple languages, manage translated products and pages, display language and currency selectors, translate SEO metadata, and synchronize supported store content with your Multipify account.

The plugin also includes the Multipify AI Store builder. It can provision a WooCommerce storefront from an authenticated Multipify blueprint, create initial pages and products, import product media and prepare the store design.

WordPress & WooCommerce translation

  • Translate WooCommerce product titles, descriptions and short descriptions.
  • Translate WordPress pages and posts.
  • Translate WooCommerce product categories and tags.
  • Translate product attributes, attribute values, variations and options.
  • Translate WordPress menus and navigation labels.
  • Translate media titles, alternative text, captions and descriptions.
  • Translate site title and tagline when enabled.
  • Translate supported rendered theme/storefront text, including headers, footers, FAQ content, tabs, widgets, buttons, forms and other detected storefront strings.
  • Translate slugs / handles when the option is enabled.
  • Keep the source language separate from target languages.
  • Store translations per language while keeping the original WordPress content available.
  • Translate individual fields with Multipify AI from the WordPress administration area.
  • Launch bulk AI translation for supported site content.
  • Translation-language access is checked against the Multipify translation credits / language allowance associated with the connected account.

Multilingual SEO

Multipify can manage translated SEO fields for supported integrations, including:

  • Yoast SEO titles and meta descriptions.
  • Rank Math titles and meta descriptions.
  • All in One SEO compatible title and description fields.
  • Selected social SEO fields and focus keywords where supported by the stored metadata.
  • Translated slugs / URLs when enabled.

Language selector

  • Display a storefront language selector.
  • Multiple presentation modes, including flag, language, country and language code combinations.
  • Dropdown or button layouts.
  • Header, top bar, menu, footer and floating placement options supplied by Multipify settings.
  • Current-language display and browser-language redirection options.
  • Selector settings are synchronized from the Multipify translation configuration.

Currency tools

  • WooCommerce currency switching support.
  • Currency selector support.
  • Automatic/local currency options supplied by Multipify settings.
  • Currency conversion applied to WooCommerce product prices when configured.
  • Language and currency controls can be used together on the storefront.

Multipify AI Store

  • Secure per-store pairing with Multipify.
  • Authenticated store provisioning through Multipify REST endpoints.
  • Automatic WooCommerce installation / activation for supported newly provisioned WordPress sites.
  • Creation of initial store pages from a Multipify AI blueprint.
  • Product creation and updates, including simple and variable products.
  • Product image and gallery import from supported source data.
  • WooCommerce storefront generation and design configuration.
  • Store content, FAQ, navigation and merchandising sections generated from the approved blueprint.
  • SEO title and description support in generated storefront data.

WooCommerce & Multipify connection

The plugin provides authenticated REST endpoints used by Multipify for supported connection, provisioning and translation workflows. Access is protected by the Multipify pairing/authentication mechanism implemented by the plugin.

WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) compatibility is declared by the connector where applicable.

External service

Multipify is an external ecommerce management and translation service available at https://multipify.eu/.

Features that communicate with Multipify, such as authenticated provisioning, synchronization and Multipify AI translation, send the information required to perform the requested operation. Depending on the feature used, this can include store configuration, content selected for translation, page/product data, language settings, generated storefront blueprint data and other store information necessary for the requested Multipify service.

Multipify AI translation sends text selected for translation and the requested target language to the Multipify service. Store provisioning can send or receive store configuration, company fields, generated page blueprint data and selected product information.

Before using connected Multipify services, review the applicable terms and privacy information on the Multipify website.

Privacy

The plugin does not need to send unrelated WordPress content merely because it is activated. Data is exchanged with Multipify when a connected feature requires it, such as pairing, provisioning, synchronization or AI translation.

Translation requests can transmit the text being translated and the selected target language to Multipify. Authenticated provisioning can exchange the store configuration and content needed to create or update the requested storefront.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the Multipify plugin ZIP from Plugins > Add New Plugin > Upload Plugin, or copy the plugin directory to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate Multipify in WordPress.
  3. Install / activate WooCommerce when using the WooCommerce ecommerce features.
  4. Make sure the WordPress site uses HTTPS.
  5. Connect or pair the store with your Multipify account using the Multipify workflow.
  6. Configure languages, translation options, selectors and currencies from Multipify / the WordPress translation tools available for the connected store.
  7. Start translation or synchronization only for the languages enabled by your Multipify translation allowance.
sections.faq:
Can Multipify translate a WordPress website?

Yes. The plugin contains translation support for WordPress pages/posts and supported rendered storefront strings. The exact content translated depends on the translation options enabled for the connected store.

Can it translate WooCommerce products?

Yes. Multipify supports WooCommerce product content and can also handle supported categories, attributes, variations, media and SEO fields when those options are enabled.

Can I translate my entire WooCommerce store with AI?

The plugin includes bulk Multipify AI translation for supported content. Translation availability is also checked against the target languages and translation allowance configured for the connected Multipify account.

Does the source language consume a target-language credit?

The plugin treats the configured source/reference language separately from target languages. Target-language access is validated against the Multipify translation configuration.

Does Multipify support multilingual SEO?

Yes. The translation module contains integrations for SEO metadata used by Yoast SEO, Rank Math and compatible All in One SEO fields, as well as translated slugs when enabled.

Can I add a language selector to my WooCommerce store?

Yes. Multipify supports a storefront language selector with multiple display styles and configurable positions. Available placement depends on the active storefront/theme structure and the settings supplied by Multipify.

Does it support multiple currencies?

Yes. The translation module includes WooCommerce currency selection and price-conversion support when currency features are configured.

Does Multipify work only with the Storefront theme?

No. Translation and selector logic is designed to work independently of a single WordPress theme. Theme markup varies, so the exact visual integration can depend on the active theme structure.

Can Multipify create a WooCommerce store?

Yes. The included Multipify AI Store builder can receive an authenticated store blueprint, prepare WooCommerce, create pages/products and build the initial storefront for supported provisioning workflows.

Is WooCommerce required?

WooCommerce is required for WooCommerce-specific catalog, product, checkout and currency features. The provisioning workflow can install/activate WooCommerce on supported fresh WordPress installations.

Is HPOS supported?

The connector declares compatibility with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage where applicable and avoids relying on direct legacy order-table access for its connector workflow.
sections.changelog:
5.19.0

  • Expanded Multipify into a multilingual WordPress and WooCommerce translation solution.
  • Added translation settings synchronized with connected Multipify stores.
  • Added source-language and target-language management.
  • Added Multipify translation-credit / language-allowance validation for AI translation actions.
  • Fixed the zero-credit case so an account without translation allowance cannot use target-language AI translation through the plugin controls.
  • Added WordPress page and post translation support.
  • Added WooCommerce product title, description and short-description translations.
  • Added product variation and option translation support.
  • Added WooCommerce category, tag, attribute and attribute-value translation support.
  • Added media translation support for title, alt text, caption and description.
  • Added menu and navigation translation support.
  • Added optional site title and tagline translation.
  • Added translation of supported rendered storefront/theme strings, including headers, footers, FAQ content, tabs, widgets, buttons and forms.
  • Added optional translated slugs / handles and multilingual URL handling.
  • Added translated internal-link handling for multilingual navigation.
  • Added multilingual SEO support for Yoast SEO, Rank Math and compatible All in One SEO metadata.
  • Added language selector settings with multiple label/display styles.
  • Added dropdown and button language-selector layouts.
  • Added configurable selector locations for headers, top bars, menus, footers and floating positions through Multipify settings.
  • Added current-language display and browser-language redirect options.
  • Added WooCommerce currency selector and currency-conversion support.
  • Added local/automatic currency configuration and combined language/currency controls.
  • Added WordPress administration screens for translation options, selectors, products, pages, categories, attributes, media and menus.
  • Added per-field Multipify AI translation from WordPress administration.
  • Added bulk AI translation for supported WordPress/WooCommerce content.
  • Added authenticated translation inventory, apply and settings REST endpoints for Multipify synchronization.
  • Improved language normalization and locale handling for regional variants.
  • Improved translated product, taxonomy, attachment and SEO data storage.
  • Improved translated URL/slug resolution and canonical handling.
  • Improved translation of dynamic/runtime storefront strings.
  • Improved selector integration so it is not limited to the Storefront theme.
  • Improved selector placement options and storefront positioning behavior.
  • Improved bottom/floating selector behavior for language choices near the viewport edge.
  • Expanded Multipify AI Store provisioning with secure per-store pairing.
  • Added authenticated provisioning status, preparation and build workflows.
  • Added automatic WooCommerce installation/activation for supported fresh WordPress sites.
  • Added AI storefront blueprint processing and initial page creation.
  • Added product import/update support with simple and variable products.
  • Improved marketplace product image and gallery importing.
  • Added generated storefront sections including navigation, product areas, FAQ and ecommerce content.
  • Added generated storefront SEO title and description support.
  • Preserved WooCommerce connector functionality and HPOS compatibility declarations.

1.1.0

  • Merged the Multipify AI Store provisioning module into Multipify Connect.
  • Added secure per-store pairing for automated provisioning.
  • Added authenticated provisioning REST endpoints.
  • Added automatic WooCommerce installation/activation for newly provisioned WordPress sites.
  • Added AI blueprint page creation and selected product import.

1.0.5

  • Prepared the plugin package for WordPress.org review.
  • Added external-service and privacy disclosures.
  • Improved error handling and accessibility for connector controls.
  • Updated WooCommerce compatibility metadata.

1.0.3

  • Added Multipify branding to the WordPress administration interface.

1.0.2

  • Added redesigned Multipify administration screens and clearer connection status.

1.0.1

  • Improved connection reliability on shared hosting environments.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
